An [[Aqualish]] '''barfly'''<ref name="Very Interesting AD">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> was a denizen of a [[bar]] on the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime]].<ref name="Very Interesting" /> Some time c. [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the individual initiated a brawl by punching [[Unidentified punched barfly|another barfly]] in the face, sending them falling to ground. After a third, [[Unidentified barfly (Borgo Prime)|human barfly]] ended up in the enemy's arms in a futile attempt to avenge their fellow patron, the punched barfly stood up to help the [[human]] barfly struggle free.<ref name="Very Interesting" />

The three individuals continued their rough-and-tumble after former [[pirate]] [[captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood]] passed by in the company of the four [[Skeleton Crew]] [[youngling]]s, who were all headed for the [[starship]] ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'', set on completing their escape from a hostile [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]].<ref name="Very Interesting" />
